faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Guwahati JRF (GATE) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for the IIT Guwahati JRF (GATE) recruitment is 23rd September 2026. Ensure your application is submitted well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the JRF (GATE) post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M. Tech degree in Chemical Engineering and have a valid GATE score to be eligible for the JRF (GATE) position at IIT Guwahati.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive. Candidates can apply without paying any application charges.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the JRF (GATE) position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the JRF (GATE) post will receive a monthly salary ranging from Rs. 37,000 to Rs. 44,400, depending on the specific terms and conditions of the appointment.

faq.question: Q5. How will the candidates be selected for the JRF (GATE) post?
faq.answer: The selection process for the JRF (GATE) position at IIT Guwahati will primarily involve an Online Interview. Candidates shortlisted based on their applications will be invited for this interview.

faq.question: Q6. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the JRF (GATE) post announced by the Indian Institute of Technology Guwahati in this recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application for the IIT Guwahati JRF (GATE) recruitment must be submitted through the Online mode. Candidates are advised to visit the official website for the application link.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The JRF (GATE) position at IIT Guwahati is a contractual job. The appointment will be on a contract basis as per the institute's policy.

faq.question: Q9. Where is IIT Guwahati located?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Technology Guwahati is located in Guwahati, Assam. The recruitment is for positions within this institute.

faq.question: Q10. What are the important dates for the application and interview process?
faq.answer: The last date for application is 23rd September 2026. Shortlisted candidates will be informed via email by 24th September 2026, and the online interview is scheduled for 25th September 2026.
